sdfTexture.label: SDF Volume (Signed Distance Field)
sdfTexture.prompt: Inspect for missing geometry, incorrect distances, or holes in the SDF. The SDF should show smooth gradient values. Hard seams or flat regions indicate voxelization or SDF computation errors.

albedoTexture.label: Albedo Volume
albedoTexture.prompt: Inspect surface colors. Red wall on left, green on right, white elsewhere. Flag incorrect or missing color regions.

cascade0_probeAtlas.label: C0 Probe Directional Atlas
cascade0_probeAtlas.prompt: Each probe owns a D x D tile. Neighboring tiles should have smoothly varying colors. Flag: uniform gray tiles (probe not baked), random noise (merge error). Bins with positive alpha = surface hit; negative = sky; zero = miss.

cascade1_probeAtlas.label: C1 Probe Directional Atlas
cascade1_probeAtlas.prompt: Same as C0 but for cascade 1 (tMax ~1.0wu after Phase 14c). Expect near-100% surface coverage. Flag dead tiles (all-zero alpha).

cascade0_probeGrid.label: C0 Isotropic Probe Grid (reduction output)
cascade0_probeGrid.prompt: Direction-averaged radiance per probe. Should show smooth spatial gradients reflecting room lighting. Flag: all-black probes, sharp grid steps, wrong colors.
